selection_rule: development world only; prefer 2 layers if its fixed endpoint passes, otherwise 4; one predeclared common budget extension if neither passes

interpretation.primary_level: controlled synthetic behavior; no universal capacity law or internal MLP attribution
interpretation.knowledge_entropy: F log2(N), conditional on relation keys; composition support adds zero independent bits
interpretation.load_graphs: closed random graphs at each N, same registered world-family seeds but different facts; not a nested-fact intervention
interpretation.world_weighting: three independent world families, one initialization each; do not pool queries as independent worlds
interpretation.budgets: 128000 updates gives identical executed-shape FLOPs; matched average record exposures is a separate comparison
